sourceText:
Pear and Stilton Starter
By: Vyvyenne
Published: Wednesday, February 23, 2011 - 5:45am

Ingredients




1 Ripe pear but not too soft  one for each guest
stilton cheese and half cream cheese again depends on how many you are doing I w
Lemon cut into wedges
green leaf salad

Preparation

1 Mix stilton and cream cheese together Take core out of pear and fill with cheese mix  place in fridge just for cheese to harden 2 When ready to serve slice pears into rounds fan shape on serving plate serve with green leaf salad and a wedge of lemon on the side.  Really a very simple to do starter and a good start to any meal. 3 I tend to make more of the cheese mixture and roll into a sausage shape and place in cling film or foil and place in fridge. Slice when firm and serve as extra on the side
